2608.30425.title: Generative Models Enhanced by Sequence Labelling and Aspect-Code Switching Improve Cross-lingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
2608.30425.paper_summary: Cross-lingual aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) transfers knowledge from a source language with annotated data to a target language, enabling fine-grained sentiment analysis without annotated target-language data. While monolingual ABSA has seen significant progress, cross-lingual ABSA remains underexplored, especially for complex tasks involving multiple sentiment elements like target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD). In this paper, we propose a novel SeqLab framework that enhances cross-lingual ABSA using a sequence-to-sequence model with an auxiliary sequence-labelling task performed by the encoder, enhancing aspect term recognition and sentiment predictions. Additionally, we incorporate aspect-code switching (ACS), a translation-based technique that swaps aspect terms between source and translated sentences, generating additional training data to enhance the model's cross-lingual understanding. We evaluate our approach across eleven languages, three domains, and two backbone models, surpassing previous state-of-the-art results for the commonly studied E2E-ABSA task. Unlike most prior work that relies solely on English as the source language, we systematically assess different source-target language pairs and extend our evaluation to the more challenging, yet underexplored TASD task in cross-lingual settings. Finally, we provide a detailed error analysis highlighting key challenges and limitations.
2608.30425.paper_summary_zh: 跨語言基於方面的情感分析（ABSA）將帶有標註數據的源語言知識轉移到目標語言，使得在沒有標註目標語言數據的情況下能夠進行細緻的情感分析。雖然單語言 ABSA 已經取得了顯著進展，但跨語言 ABSA 仍然未被充分探索，特別是在涉及多個情感元素的複雜任務中，如目標-方面-情感檢測（TASD）。在本文中，我們提出了一種新穎的 SeqLab 框架，利用序列到序列模型和編碼器執行的輔助序列標註任務來增強跨語言 ABSA，從而提高方面術語識別和情感預測。此外，我們還納入了方面代碼切換（ACS），這是一種基於翻譯的技術，能在源語句和翻譯語句之間交換方面術語，生成額外的訓練數據以增強模型的跨語言理解。我們在十一種語言、三個領域和兩個主幹模型上評估了我們的方法，超越了以往在常見的 E2E-ABSA 任務上的最新技術結果。與大多數先前的工作僅依賴英語作為源語言不同，我們系統性地評估了不同的源-目標語言對，並將我們的評估擴展到更具挑戰性但尚未充分探索的跨語言環境中的 TASD 任務。最後，我們提供了詳細的錯誤分析，突顯了關鍵挑戰和限制。
